title: Queen for a Square
setup: Your queen and rook are stacked on the d-file, and the black king has no air behind its pawns.
hint: The back rank is the weakness. What can you put on d8 that Black is obliged to capture?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd8+}} offers the queen on the one square Black must take: {{Qxd8}} is its only legal move. The black queen now stands on the back rank in front of your rook, and {{Rxd8#}} ends it. Ask which square would be fatal for an enemy piece, then make it go there.
